name: Mark Bradley
headline: Senior Full-Stack Developer
summary: Full-stack developer with 15+ years building web platforms for banks, broadcasters and energy companies (BMO, Nordea, Ørsted, CBC). Strongest in TypeScript, React, Angular and Node.js, with PostgreSQL, MongoDB and AWS. Recently shipped two apps to Google Play as a founder; daily user of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex) since 2023.

bullets: Shipped Reveller and sister app Poekito to Google Play (Flutter, Kotlin, Dart API, PostgreSQL).
Built Chatelope, an AI chat manager (Next.js, React 19, Flutter) syncing ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini history.
Built PricedOff, price tracking for 7 Amazon marketplaces (React, TypeScript, Node.js, MongoDB, AWS).

experience.title: Lead Software Developer
bullets: Built a greenfield nonprofit platform with Next.js, TypeScript, Payload CMS and PostgreSQL.
Added Google and Apple sign-in, multilingual support, and NGINX/PM2 deployment with CI/CD.

experience.title: Senior Frontend Developer
bullets: Built the frontend of a commodities trading position-management tool, upgrading it from Angular 13 to 18.
Wrote a Node.js CLI that migrated data between trading systems through API orchestration.
Deployed Angular apps with Docker and Kubernetes through Azure CI/CD pipelines.

experience.title: Senior Frontend Developer
bullets: Built and launched the Accounts & Transactions module (Angular 9) for customer balances and transactions.
Helped migrate the banking platform from AngularJS to Angular 9; reviewed team code every sprint.

experience.title: Senior UI Developer
bullets: Led a UI team of 4 on myWealth, BMO's wealth onboarding app (Angular, Angular Material, Node.js).
Redesigned the Smartfolio robo-investor tool; implemented English/French localization.

experience.title: Interactive Developer
bullets: Built React single-page apps with MongoDB; automated ad build and deploy workflows with Node.js.

experience.title: Co-founder & Consultant
bullets: Consulting for clients including Scotiabank, RBC, TD, BMO, Bell Media, Telus and Loblaws Digital.

experience.title: Senior UI Developer
